name: Super Doublet
description: The Super Doublet is a center-fed HF wire antenna of any convenient length, fed with open-wire line and matched with a balanced tuner. It is one of the most efficient and flexible multiband HF antennas available.
modelingNotes: Total wire length determines lobe structure and multiband behavior.
Open-wire feedline minimizes loss even at high SWR.
Height above ground controls takeoff angle more than wire length.
Balanced tuner is required for proper matching across HF bands.
Longer doublets (>1λ) develop multiple lobes with DX potential.
